title: Quick Garlicky Jamaican Turkey Skillet
description: A flavorful and quick Jamaican dish featuring turkey, garlic, and a blend of spices, cooked to perfection in a molcajete, with a deglazing step that adds a rich and savory element to the dish, making it a great option for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large molcajete over medium-high heat.
Add the turkey to the molcajete and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, scotch bonnet peppers, allspice, and thyme to the molcajete and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth to the molcajete and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, until the turkey is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Season the turkey with salt and black pepper to taste.
Stir in the chopped scallions and serve hot.
Deglaze the molcajete with a little bit of chicken broth if necessary, to loosen any browned bits.
